item.stem:
Farhan looks at the diagram. Straight line $AOB$ meets at $O$, and ray $OP$ cuts the straight angle into adjacent angles $\angle AOP$ and $\angle POB$. The marked angle $\angle POB$ is $65^{\circ}$.

Which claim correctly finds $\angle AOP$?

options.A: Call the answer the ray $OP$, and stop.
options.B: Finding $\angle AOP$ is what creates the straight line $AOB$.
options.C: $\angle AOP=180^{\circ}-65^{\circ}=115^{\circ}$, because adjacent angles on a straight line make $180^{\circ}$.
options.D: $\angle AOP=65^{\circ}$, matching the largest printed degree mark in the diagram.
